description: This source file defines the AttributeModified event class in Java, which models an event emitted after a Thing's attribute has been modified within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains methods for constructing instances, parsing JSON, and accessing event data related to attribute modifications.

classes.name: AttributeModified
classes.description: Model class representing an event fired after a Thing's attribute has been modified within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details about the attribute change, such as the attribute's JSON pointer, its new value, revision, timestamp, headers, and optional metadata. Provides static factory methods for creation and JSON deserialization, along with accessors and overrides for standard object methods.

methods.description: Static method to parse a JSON string or object and create an AttributeModified instance, given appropriate headers.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer identifying the modified attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the JsonValue representing the new value of the modified attribute.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.description: Builds JSON payload for the event, including the attribute pointer and value, respecting schema version and predicate filters.
